enforced: PageSpecs carry no raw style values: the schema has no style/token-override field (additionalProperties:false everywhere).
Semantic/component tokens must resolve through tokens/themes/dark.json (checked by extraction/verify_all.py).
Primitive/component contracts may only reference catalog token ids (checked by extraction/verify_all.py).
convention: Prefer semantic ids (text.secondary) over foundation ids (color.white-alpha.60) in new component code.
Hover is color-only (300/400ms); CTAs have no hover; wrap hover rules in (hover:hover).
Use Tailwind v4 semantics when porting: rounded-sm = 4px, divide-y = border-bottom on all but last child.

rawValueRestrictions.color: no raw literals in generated component code - reference a 'color' token
